subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A restaurant placed a clear scale near the kitchen to weigh food waste every night.”?
options: A teacher took a photo and posted it on the community board.
When the photos were finally printed, not all of them were good.
The school changed its bell to a short song written by students.
The number was written on a board for all workers to see.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A teacher took a photo and posted it on the community board.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「When the photos were finally printed, not all of them were good.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The school changed its bell to a short song written by students.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The number was written on a board for all workers to see.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The number was written on a board for all workers to see.」，答案為「The number was written on a board for all workers to see.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The number was written on a board for all workers to see.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
